text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Pilots of state airline TAP-Air Portugal, protesting against pressures to work supplementary shifts during designated rest periods, set to strike on March 15.
- Two main pulp producers published 1996 results yesterday. Soporcel showed a 0.3 billion escudo profit and Portucel a 1.37 billion escudo loss.

- Portugal runs the risk of not entering Economic and Monetary Union in the first wave unless parliament revises article 105 of the constitution which refers to the relationship between the Bank of Portugal and the government, according to Francisco Torres, MP of the opposition Social Democratic Party.
- Secil plans to establish a cement manufacturer in China, in partnership with Chinese investors, in a 10 billion escudo deal.
